tower.ok: Every block lands and the tower stands.
tower.ko: One block too many: the tower sways and it falls.

bridge.ok: The plank is long enough: the bridge closes.
bridge.ko: The plank is too short: the gap stays open.

scale.ok: Both sides weigh the same: the scale balances.
scale.ko: One side is heavier: the scale tips.

jug.ok: The water stops right on the line.
jug.ko: Too much water: the jug overflows.

shelf.ok: Every piece fits in its spot.
shelf.ko: One piece too many: it bounces off the shelf.

collide.ok: The push is just right: the block stops in the zone.
collide.ko: The push is off: the block misses the zone.

tower.over: {given} blocks instead of {right}: the tower falls.
tower.under: {given} blocks instead of {right}: the tower stays too short.

bridge.ok: A plank of {right}: the bridge closes.
bridge.over: A plank of {given} instead of {right}: the gap stays open.
bridge.under: A plank of {given} instead of {right}: the gap stays open.

scale.ok: {right} on each side: the scale balances.

jug.ok: {right}: the water stops right on the line.
jug.under: {given} instead of {right}: the water stays under the line.

shelf.over: {given} pieces for {right} spots: the extra ones roll off.
shelf.under: {given} pieces for {right} spots: a spot stays empty.

collide.ok: A push of {right}: the block stops in the zone.
collide.over: A push of {given} instead of {right}: the block goes too far.
collide.under: A push of {given} instead of {right}: the block stops short.
